crossRefs.note: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says to them: ‘Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.
“I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.
I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live…
My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats; For Yahweh of Armies has visited his…
Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the…
He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

translations.web: “As for you, O my flock, the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the male goats.
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says to you, My flock: ‘I will judge between one sheep and another, between the rams and the goats.
translations.kjv: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
translations.asv: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I judge between sheep and sheep, the rams and the he-goats.
